title: The Rise of the Vígszínház and Urban Comedy
grammar: Jussive and concessive subjunctive clauses (akárhogy is + -jon/-jen)
goal: I can say what the Vígszínház (1896) changed in Hungarian acting.
I can use the 3rd-person subjunctive for a demand (Lássa a közönség!) and akárhogy is + subjunctive.
I can talk about comedy, dialogue and Molnár Ferenc's success abroad.
